title: HelperFSRootResult
description: Result of the helper fs service's root op: where the file tree starts, how a header abbreviates it, and whether it is an inference. The reason is required alongside the flag — a root the product guessed must say why, or the person reads a guess as their own directory.

path.description: The root's real path, as the provider reports it.

display.description: The abbreviated form for a header: a path under the account's home is written with a tilde.

inferred.description: Whether this root is the home directory standing in for one the caller verified.

inferredReason.description: Why it was inferred; empty when it was not. Required so 'not inferred' is an answer and not an absent field.
